faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II position is 28 August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./M.Sc (Tech) in Geophysics/ Applied Geophysics with a minimum of 2 years of research experience post their M.Sc./M.Sc(Tech) from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - II position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate - II position at CSIR - National Institute of Oceanography.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate - II position will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.answer: CSIR - National Institute of Oceanography is located in Goa.

faq.answer: The position of Project Associate - II is on a contractual basis.
